name: Stationary Split Squat

instructions.description: Stand in a staggered stance with feet on separate tracks.
Lower vertically by bending both knees while keeping the front foot supported.
Stop at a comfortable depth with the trunk controlled.
Press through the feet to return to the start, then change sides.

variations.variationDescription: Reverse Lunge meaningfully changes the difficulty, loading, support, or movement demands compared with Stationary Split Squat.
Stationary Split Squat — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Stationary Split Squat — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Use stable support if balance limits the movement.
